functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Generate an OMOP cohort at all organizations from SQL or ATLAS JSON and aggregate exact patient counts.

arguments.name: sql
arguments.description: OHDSI CohortGenerator SQL. Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json.

arguments.name: atlas_json
arguments.description: ATLAS cohort expression JSON. Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json.

arguments.name: cohort_id
arguments.description: Positive cohort identifier. If omitted, the central function generates one.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Whether federated nodes may replace an existing cohort with the same id.

functions.name: generate_cohort_count
functions.description: Generate a cohort on an OMOP node and return the exact subject count.

arguments.name: cohort_id
arguments.description: Positive cohort identifier to generate at this node.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Whether to replace an existing cohort with the same id.

databases.name: omop
databases.description: OMOP CDM database configured with DATABASE_TYPE=OMOP and DB_PARAM_* connection values.
